data.label: CMS Inpatient Claim Governed Record
data.description: A CMS inpatient claim record. The governed record: the data cluster, the PROV activity and agent and the audit event from the ProvGov library by identifier. Members: CMS Inpatient Claim; prov-activity (Provgov); prov-agent (Provgov); audit-event (Provgov).

items.label: Audit Event
items.description: A logged access or custody event as data: what was done, by whom, on what, with what outcome and for what purpose. The audit-only case of sdc5 issue 002; state-changing operations are workflow transitions.

items.label: Audit Agent Reference
items.description: The acting agent (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.who). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Entity Reference
items.description: The entity the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.entity.what). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Audit Event Identifier
items.description: The identifier of the audit event.

items.label: Data Subject Reference
items.description: The data subject or patient the event concerns (FHIR AuditEvent.patient; SDC DM.subject). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The party on whose behalf the agent acted (FHIR agent.onBehalfOf; prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: System Identifier
items.description: The system that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.source.observer; SDC AuditType.system-id).

items.label: System Location Name
items.description: The site or facility that handled the item (FHIR AuditEvent.agent.location; prov:atLocation).

items.label: Audit Event Action
items.description: The operation performed in a logged access event (FHIR AuditEvent.action). Read and Execute change no state and are audit facts, not workflow moves.

items.label: Audit Event Outcome
items.description: The result of an audited event (FHIR AuditEvent.outcome).

items.label: Confidentiality
items.description: The level of protection the information requires (HL7 v3 Confidentiality). At assembly the value populates a component's act tag.

items.label: Provenance Agent Type
items.description: The functional role of an agent in an activity (FHIR Provenance.agent.type).

items.label: Purpose of Use
items.description: Why the information was used (HL7 v3 ActReason purpose of use). Activity context, not an access-control tag.

items.label: Audit Recorded At
items.description: When the audit event was recorded (FHIR AuditEvent.recorded).

items.label: CMS Inpatient Claim
items.description: One DE-SynPUF inpatient claim (2008-2010): the beneficiary and claim identifiers, the stay as the FHIR encounter by identifier with admission and discharge dates, provider and physicians, the payment, per diem, deductible and coinsurance amounts, utilization days, the DRG, the admitting diagnosis, up to ten diagnoses, six procedures and ten HCPCS codes as ICD-9-CM and HCPCS coded values. Members: Beneficiary Code (DESYNPUF_ID); Claim ID (CLM_ID); Claim Line Segment (SEGMENT); encounter (FHIR); Provider Institution (PRVDR_NUM); Claim Payment Amount; Primary Payer Claim Paid Amount; Attending Physician NPI (AT_PHYSN_NPI); Operating Physician NPI (OP_PHYSN_NPI); Other Physician NPI (OT_PHYSN_NPI); Blood Deductible Liability Amount; Claim Admission Date (CLM_ADMSN_DT); Beneficiary Discharge Date (NCH_BENE_DSCHRG_DT); Claim Pass-Through Per Diem Amount; Inpatient Deductible Amount; Part A Coinsurance Liability Amount; Claim Utilization Day Count (CLM_UTLZTN_DAY_CNT); Diagnosis Related Group Code (CLM_DRG_CD); Admitting Diagnosis; Claim Diagnosis 1; Claim Diagnosis 2; Claim Diagnosis 3; Claim Diagnosis 4; Claim Diagnosis 5; Claim Diagnosis 6; Claim Diagnosis 7; Claim Diagnosis 8; Claim Diagnosis 9; Claim Diagnosis 10; Claim Procedure 1; Claim Procedure 2; Claim Procedure 3; Claim Procedure 4; Claim Procedure 5; Claim Procedure 6; Claim HCPCS 1; Claim HCPCS 2; Claim HCPCS 3; Claim HCPCS 4; Claim HCPCS 5; Claim HCPCS 6; Claim HCPCS 7; Claim HCPCS 8; Claim HCPCS 9; Claim HCPCS 10.

items.label: Attending Physician NPI (AT_PHYSN_NPI)
items.description: The attending physician's National Provider Identifier (AT_PHYSN_NPI).

items.label: Beneficiary Code (DESYNPUF_ID)
items.description: The synthetic beneficiary identifier every DE-SynPUF file carries (DESYNPUF_ID); not traceable to a real Medicare beneficiary.

items.label: Claim ID (CLM_ID)
items.description: The claim identifier (CLM_ID).

items.label: Diagnosis Related Group Code (CLM_DRG_CD)
items.description: The claim's diagnosis related group code (CLM_DRG_CD).

items.label: Operating Physician NPI (OP_PHYSN_NPI)
items.description: The operating physician's National Provider Identifier (OP_PHYSN_NPI).

items.label: Other Physician NPI (OT_PHYSN_NPI)
items.description: The other physician's National Provider Identifier (OT_PHYSN_NPI).

items.label: Provider Institution (PRVDR_NUM)
items.description: The provider institution number (PRVDR_NUM).

items.label: Claim Line Segment (SEGMENT)
items.description: The claim line segment (SEGMENT).

items.label: Claim Utilization Day Count (CLM_UTLZTN_DAY_CNT)
items.description: The number of covered days on the claim (CLM_UTLZTN_DAY_CNT).

items.label: Blood Deductible Liability Amount
items.description: The beneficiary's blood deductible liability (NCH_BENE_BLOOD_DDCTBL_LBLTY_AM), in US dollars.

items.label: Claim Pass-Through Per Diem Amount
items.description: The pass-through per diem amount (CLM_PASS_THRU_PER_DIEM_AMT), in US dollars.

items.label: Claim Payment Amount
items.description: The amount Medicare paid on the claim (CLM_PMT_AMT), in US dollars.

items.label: Inpatient Deductible Amount
items.description: The beneficiary's inpatient deductible (NCH_BENE_IP_DDCTBL_AMT), in US dollars.

items.label: Part A Coinsurance Liability Amount
items.description: The beneficiary's Part A coinsurance liability (NCH_BENE_PTA_COINSRNC_LBLTY_AM), in US dollars.

items.label: Primary Payer Claim Paid Amount
items.description: The amount a primary payer paid on the claim (NCH_PRMRY_PYR_CLM_PD_AMT), in US dollars.

items.label: Beneficiary Discharge Date (NCH_BENE_DSCHRG_DT)
items.description: The inpatient discharge date (NCH_BENE_DSCHRG_DT).

items.label: Claim Admission Date (CLM_ADMSN_DT)
items.description: The inpatient admission date (CLM_ADMSN_DT).

items.label: Admitting Diagnosis
items.description: The admitting diagnosis (ADMTNG_ICD9_DGNS_CD) as an ICD-9-CM coded value. Members: Diagnosis (ICD-9-CM).

items.label: Diagnosis (ICD-9-CM)
items.description: A diagnosis coded in ICD-9-CM: the code, its display text and the fixed code system (FHIR Coding). What the 2008-2010 claims carry; not mapped to ICD-10-CM. Members: Diagnosis Code (ICD-9-CM); code-display-text (FHIR); Code System: ICD-9-CM.

items.label: Code System: ICD-9-CM
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: ICD-9-CM (http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/icd-9-cm). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Diagnosis Code (ICD-9-CM)
items.description: An ICD-9-CM diagnosis code as recorded on a 2008-2010 Medicare claim, without the decimal point as CMS files carry it.

items.label: Code Display Text
items.description: The human-readable display of a coded value, as recorded with the code (FHIR Coding.display).

items.label: Claim Diagnosis 1
items.description: Diagnosis code 1 on the claim (ICD9_DGNS_CD_1) as an ICD-9-CM coded value. Members: Diagnosis (ICD-9-CM).

items.label: Claim Diagnosis 10
items.description: Diagnosis code 10 on the claim (ICD9_DGNS_CD_10) as an ICD-9-CM coded value. Members: Diagnosis (ICD-9-CM).

items.label: Claim HCPCS 1
items.description: HCPCS code 1 on the claim (HCPCS_CD_1) as a coded value; the first ten of the file's forty-five line slots are carried. Members: Procedure (HCPCS).

items.label: Procedure (HCPCS)
items.description: A procedure or service coded in HCPCS: the code, its display text and the fixed code system (FHIR Coding). Members: HCPCS Code; code-display-text (FHIR); Code System: HCPCS.

items.label: Code System: HCPCS
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: HCPCS Level I (CPT) and Level II (http://www.ama-assn.org/go/cpt and https://www.cms.gov/medicare/coding-billing/healthcare-common-procedure-system). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: HCPCS Code
items.description: A HCPCS code as recorded on a Medicare claim line: five characters, CPT (Level I) or Level II.

items.label: Claim HCPCS 10
items.description: HCPCS code 10 on the claim (HCPCS_CD_10) as a coded value; the first ten of the file's forty-five line slots are carried. Members: Procedure (HCPCS).

items.label: Procedure (ICD-9-CM)
items.description: A procedure coded in ICD-9-CM volume 3: the code, its display text and the fixed code system (FHIR Coding). Members: Procedure Code (ICD-9-CM); code-display-text (FHIR); Code System: ICD-9-CM.

items.label: Procedure Code (ICD-9-CM)
items.description: An ICD-9-CM volume 3 procedure code as recorded on a Medicare inpatient claim, without the decimal point.

items.label: Encounter
items.description: An interaction between a patient and healthcare providers: status, class, priority, reason, period, length and hospitalization.

items.label: Encounter Class
items.description: The setting of the encounter (HL7 v3 ActEncounterCode). FHIR Encounter.class; ActCode, version 11.0.0.

items.label: Encounter Priority
items.description: The urgency of the encounter (HL7 v3 ActPriority). FHIR Encounter.priority; ActPriority, version 5.0.0.

items.label: Encounter Status
items.description: The lifecycle state of the encounter. FHIR Encounter.status; EncounterStatus, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Encounter Length
items.description: How long the encounter lasted, in the Default time units. FHIR Encounter.length.

items.label: Encounter End
items.description: When the encounter ended. FHIR Encounter.period.end.

items.label: Encounter Start
items.description: When the encounter started. FHIR Encounter.period.start.

items.label: Encounter Reason (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The reason the encounter takes place. A coded value: the SNOMED CT code, its display text and the fixed code system, resolved on the code system IRI (FHIR Coding). FHIR Encounter.reasonCode.

items.label: Code System: SNOMED CT
items.description: The code system of a coded value, fixed: SNOMED CT (http://snomed.info/sct). FHIR Coding.system.

items.label: Encounter Reason Code (SNOMED CT)
items.description: The SNOMED CT code for the reason the encounter takes place. FHIR Encounter.reasonCode, coded in http://snomed.info/sct.

items.label: Hospitalization
items.description: The admission and discharge facts of an inpatient encounter.

items.label: Admit Source
items.description: Where the patient was admitted from. FHIR Encounter.hospitalization.admitSource; Admit source, version 4.0.1.

items.label: Discharge Disposition
items.description: Where the patient went on discharge. FHIR Encounter.hospitalization.dischargeDisposition; Discharge disposition, version 4.0.1.

items.label: PROV Activity
items.description: A PROV activity: what it was, when it ran, its status, and the entities, activities, agent and plan it relates to.

items.label: Activity Description
items.description: A description of what the activity does and why.

items.label: Activity Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV activity: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Activity Label
items.description: A human-readable label for a PROV activity.

items.label: Activity Location
items.description: Where the activity took place (prov:atLocation), as text.

items.label: Activity Type
items.description: The kind of activity, in the vocabulary of the domain (prov:type).

items.label: Error Message
items.description: The error the activity reported, if it failed.

items.label: Had Plan Reference
items.description: The plan the activity followed (prov:hadPlan). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Used Entity Reference
items.description: An entity the activity used (prov:used). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Associated With Reference
items.description: The agent associated with the activity (prov:wasAssociatedWith). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Ended By Reference
items.description: The entity that ended the activity (prov:wasEndedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Informed By Reference
items.description: An activity that informed this one (prov:wasInformedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Was Started By Reference
items.description: The entity that started the activity (prov:wasStartedBy). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Activity Status
items.description: The state of an activity, from the Data Privacy Vocabulary activity status concepts.

items.label: Ended At
items.description: When the activity ended (prov:endedAtTime).

items.label: Started At
items.description: When the activity started (prov:startedAtTime).

items.label: PROV Agent
items.description: A PROV agent: a person, organization or software agent, with its identity, contact and delegation.

items.label: Acted On Behalf Of Reference
items.description: The agent on whose behalf this agent acted (prov:actedOnBehalfOf). Holds the IRI of the referenced thing.

items.label: Agent Description
items.description: A description of the agent and its responsibilities.

items.label: Agent Email
items.description: The agent's email address (foaf:mbox).

items.label: Agent Identifier
items.description: The identifier of a PROV agent: a URI or another globally unique identifier.

items.label: Agent Name
items.description: The name of the agent (foaf:name).

items.label: Agent Organization Name
items.description: The organization the agent belongs to or is.

items.label: Software Name
items.description: The name of a software agent.

items.label: Software Version
items.description: The version of a software agent.

items.label: PROV Agent Type
items.description: The kind of PROV agent: person, organization or software agent.
